item.title: Golding to earn almost $7 million in first season leading Rebels
item.description: Ole Miss’ Pete Golding is scheduled to make a base salary of $6.8 million in his first season as head coach, according to a term sheet obtained by the Daily Journal. Golding, who was recently promoted from defensive coordinator following Lane Kiffin’s departure to LSU, will receive a base-salary raise of $100,000 per year for five years, culminating in a base salary of $7.2 million in 2030. The post Golding to earn almost $7 million in first season leading Rebels appeared first on The Dispatch.

item.title: MSU professor’s artwork selected for new Greenville federal courthouse
item.description: When visitors step into the new federal courthouse in Greenville next year, one of the first things they will see is a vast, hand-crafted landscape of river, sky, and Delta earth – an artwork designed and built by Mississippi State University professor Critz Campbell.
